caseNameFull: Rapanos v. United States and Carabell v. United States Army Corps of Engineers

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 932.] Motion of petitioners to deconsolidate cases denied. Motion of petitioners for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: 20 minutes for petitioners in No. 04-1034; 20 minutes for petitioners in No. 04-1384; 40 minutes for respondents.
